newsitem.title: CANADA: Molson to sell unit to Henkel.
newsitem.headline: Molson to sell unit to Henkel.

text.p: Molson Cos Ltd said on Thursday it had signed a binding deal with Germany's Henkel KGaA under which Molson will sell its Novamax Technologies business to Henkel for C$255 million.
Molson said it will withdraw C$20 million in cash from the business prior to the signing of the definitive deal which will occur on or before October 9.

When the definitive agreement is signed, one-half of the proceeds will be paid to Molson. The other half will be held in escrow and will be paid to Molson as regulatory approvals are obtained in various jurisdictions.

The remaining proceeds will be paid in any event no later than 365 days after signing. Molson said Novamax specialty chemicals business had sales of C$284 million and earnings before interest and taxes of C$21.7 million for the year ending March 31 of this year.
Molson said this sale completes the divestiture of the former Diversey Group of Cos.
